informational.text: `--ds-dropdown-panel-min-width` defaults to `240px` and floors the `ds-select`, `ds-multi-select` and `ds-autocomplete` panel in both `width` modes, so a panel under a trigger narrower than 240px is 240px wide; a wider trigger still sets the width. Set `--ds-dropdown-panel-min-width: 0` on the component to keep a panel as wide as its trigger.
informational.verify: Open a ds-select narrower than 240px and confirm its panel is 240px wide, then open one beside the right edge of the viewport and confirm the panel stays on screen.
